title: On the Glow Mini Glowy Super Gel™ with Mini Vanity Case Gift Set

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, antioxidants, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean + Planet Aware
What it is: A limited-edition Mini Red Vanity Case paired with Mini Glowy Super Gel in Sunglow for an effortless back-from-vacation glow, wherever you go.

What Else You Need to Know: Glow on the go with this limited-edition duo featuring Mini Glowy Super Gel in Sunglow and a Mini Red Vanity Case. The lightweight illuminator adds an effortless golden glow to skin, while the case keeps your essentials close wherever the day takes you.

This Set Contains:
- 0.5 oz/14.79 mL Glowy Super Gel Sunglow
- Mini Vanity Case (red)

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is our commitment to offering effective products without certain ingredients, such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and mineral oils. Learn more How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply one to two pumps of Mini Glowy Super Gel all over as your forever first step for glowing skin.
-Use fingertips or The Big Brush (sold separately) to blend in.
Ingredients+
Aqua/Water/Eau, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propanediol, Glycerin, Mica, Squalane, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Polysorbate 60, Sorbitan Isostearate, Phenethyl Alcohol, Caprylyl Glycol, Tocopherol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Lactic Acid. [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77499)].
